PREFIX ref: <http://w3id.org/brickschema/2020-04-27/ref#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?zone ?zoneName ?point ?tsId WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasName ?zoneName .
  ?point a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point brick:hasSubclass ?p .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsId .
}
